elements.text: ASX: AAL — Investor update
Alfabs Australia Limited

A founder-led Hunter Valley group: heavy steel fabrication, underground mining equipment, protective coatings and heavy transport. Over 300 people, one design-to-delivery promise — Quality, Safety, Delivery.
WHERE WE OPERATE
Kurri Kurri NSW (head offices)   ·   Unanderra NSW   ·   Narrabri NSW   ·   Parramatta NSW   ·   Paget, Mackay QLD

slots.title: Four divisions, one design-to-delivery group
slots.col.1.heading: Alfabs Engineering
slots.col.1.body: Heavy structural steel fabrication, detailed pipe and duct work, and onsite construction and maintenance. CC3-certified to AS/NZS 5131 for welding, architecturally exposed structural steel and protective coatings.
slots.col.2.heading: Alfabs Mining Equipment
slots.col.2.body: Supply, manufacture, service, repair and hire of underground mining equipment across Hunter Valley, Wollongong, Narrabri and Mackay workshops. Includes Alfabs Stonedust Solutions and Alfabs Store.
slots.col.3.heading: Alfabs Protective Coatings
slots.col.3.body: Abrasive blasting and protective coatings in a purpose-built blast chamber, plus onsite paint and blast and hazardous coatings management. Accredited to PCCP Classes 1–6.
slots.col.4.heading: Alfabs Transport & Logistics
slots.col.4.body: Oversize overmass (OSOM) specialists under NHVR permits, moving mobile plant, structural steel and containers 24/7 across NSW, QLD and the eastern states.

Continuous miners · QDS BOAR bolters · Torque Titan LHDs · Feeder breakers · Auxiliary fans · Air track and multi bolters · Work platforms and accessories · Access and ventilation doors. Every unit ships with a complete Plant Safety File.

Safety and certifications
“Prevention before harm.” The objective is that every employee returns home safely, in the same physical and emotional condition in which they arrived.
MANAGEMENT SYSTEMS

ISO 9001:2015 Quality Management
ISO 45001:2018 Occupational Health & Safety
ISO 14001:2015 Environmental Management
AS/NZS ISO/IEC 17020:2013 Conformity Assessment
Transport for NSW (TfNSW) CC3 Prequalification
PRODUCT AND PROCESS

Steelwork Compliance Australia (AS/NZS 5131)
ISO 3834.2 welding manufacturer certification
Steel Sustainability Australia (Level 2)
CSIRO Painting Contractor Certification Program
ANZEx Recognised Service Facility for Ex diesel
Protective coatings work is accredited to PCCP Classes 1–6; paint inspectors hold AMPP CIP Level 1 and Level 2.

slots.title: Customers
slots.lead: Alfabs Mining is likely to have provided a piece of equipment in every underground coal mine in Australia, and the group delivers for energy, infrastructure and construction clients across New South Wales and beyond.
bullets: Northern Concourse Roof, Central Station Sydney — engaged early with client Laing O’Rourke, then fabricated, coated, pre-assembled, transported and installed by Alfabs teams
NCIG Shiploader Recovery; Sydney Light Rail; Parramatta Light Rail; Wickham Transport Interchange
Minimbah Reservoir Tank; Barnsley Weir Bridge; Tippler Footbridge; Moparrabah Road Beams
Bulk stone dust products used in 90% of NSW underground mines
Clients consistently score Alfabs 4 stars or more for communication

slots.title: Capital and outlook
events: 1950s — formed as Alfabs Engineers, the origin of the ‘AE’ ball in the logo
1986 — owned and operated by the same family, from a ute and a handful of workers
2021 — purpose-built stone dust facility completed at Kurri Kurri
June 2024 — lists on the ASX as Alfabs Australia Limited (AAL) after a restructure; founder led, family majority ownership retained
February 2025 — half-year result and maiden dividend
2026 — organisational restructure and debt refinancing update; investor day update and acquisition update released
